the important role of vascular EpoR to promote VEGF expression and angiogenesis in ischemia.
the role of erythropoietic receptor in angiogenesis.
the important role of Epo/EpoR system in angiogenesis.

the vascular EpoR is a critical regulator of angiogenesis and vascular repair in peripheral ischemia.

vascular Epo/EpoR system plays an important role not only in the protection of pulmonary hypertension but also in angiogenesis in peripheral ischemia.

Epo/EpoR system is a key regulator for angiogenesis and vascular remodeling in response to ischemic stress.

the EPO/EPOR system plays an important role for angiogenesis after ischemia in the hind limb.
the EpoR system plays an essential role in angiogenesis and blood flow recovery in hindlimb ischemic mice.
